props.hook: My neighbour left notes on my car
props.story: Every morning for a month, my neighbour left a sticky note on my car. Just one word. Smile. I thought it was creepy, so one night I waited up to catch them. It was the old man from number four. He said his wife used to leave him notes like that. Since she passed, he leaves one for whoever looks like they need it most.
